Computed styles: perspective=1200px, transformStyle=preserve-3d, backfaceVisibility=hidden on front face, back face has rotateY(180deg) matrix3d transform. Global CSS classes in globals.css lines 165-191 are correctly webkit-prefixed. Navbar.tsx line ~79 gates the mobile menu button behind {currentUser && (...)}. rca_of_the_issue: BUG1 RCA: Tailwind arbitrary-value classes like [backface-visibility:hidden] compile to raw property only, without -webkit- prefix. Safari on iOS (WebKit) requires the -webkit-backface-visibility variant to actually hide the mirrored back-face during a 3D rotateY flip; otherwise the reversed text of the opposite face bleeds through. Fix moves the flip-card 3D properties into globals.css classes that explicitly include both -webkit- and standard variants for perspective, transform-style, backface-visibility, and transform. BUG2 RCA: Navbar's mobile hamburger button was unconditionally rendered, but DashboardShell only mounts <AppSidebar/> (which contains the mobile drawer) when currentUser is truthy. As a guest, tapping the button dispatched onToggleSidebar which set isMobileSidebarOpen=true but there was no <AppSidebar/> to respond, so nothing happened. Fix: gate the mobile menu button in Navbar.tsx behind {currentUser && (...)} so guests do not see a dead button; the button is only rendered where an AppSidebar actually exists to open.
